_comment: Recipes the kitchen's batching system does not carry. Same shape as an imported one, applied on top by scripts/import_recipes.py. Anything in here is a recipe somebody stated directly rather than one copied from an existing system, so each records who said so and when.

Pork Chasiu.note: cooked here from pork belly; the batching system carries no recipe for it. Water is not a line: it is mains water with no lot to trace, and none of the kitchen's own twenty-four recipes lists it either, including the broths that are mostly water.

lines.note: stated as Kikkoman, which is japanese soy sauce (Dean, 2026-09-01)
